mapper.sql: select s.id as id, s.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, date_format(s.collected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as collectedAt, s.avg_temp as avgTemp, s.max_temp as maxTemp, s.min_temp as minTemp, s.layer_1_avg as layer1Avg, s.layer_2_avg as layer2Avg, s.layer_3_avg as layer3Avg, s.layer_4_avg as layer4Avg, s.warning_level as warningLevel, s.warning_flag as warningFlag, s.warning_message as warningMessage, s.analysis_result as analysisResult

from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on s.warehouse_id = w.id where (#{warehouseId} is null or s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}) and (#{startTime} is null or s.collected_at >= #{startTime}) and (#{endTime} is null or s.collected_at <= #{endTime}) and (#{warningLevel} is null or #{warningLevel} = '' or s.warning_level = #{warningLevel}) and (#{tempMin} is null or s.avg_temp >= #{tempMin}) and (#{tempMax} is null or s.avg_temp <= #{tempMax})
and ( w.warehouse_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(s.warning_level, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(s.warning_message, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(s.analysis_result, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(s.avg_temp as char) like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(s.max_temp as char) like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(s.min_temp as char) like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or date_format(s.collected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.insert: insert into grain_temp_summary ( warehouse_id, collected_at, avg_temp, max_temp, min_temp, layer_1_avg, layer_2_avg, layer_3_avg, layer_4_avg, warning_level, warning_flag, warning_message, analysis_result, analysis_remark ) values ( #{warehouseId}, #{collectedAt}, #{avgTemp}, #{maxTemp}, #{minTemp}, #{layer1Avg}, #{layer2Avg}, #{layer3Avg}, #{layer4Avg}, #{warningLevel}, #{warningFlag}, #{warningMessage}, #{analysisResult}, #{analysisRemark} ) on duplicate key update avg_temp = values(avg_temp), max_temp = values(max_temp), min_temp = values(min_temp), layer_1_avg = values(layer_1_avg), layer_2_avg = values(layer_2_avg), layer_3_avg = values(layer_3_avg), layer_4_avg = values(layer_4_avg), warning_level = values(warning_level), warning_flag = values(warning_flag), warning_message = values(warning_message), analysis_result = values(analysis_result), analysis_remark = values(analysis_remark)
mapper.select: from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on s.warehouse_id = w.id where (#{warehouseId} is null or s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}) and (#{startTime} is null or s.collected_at >= #{startTime}) and (#{endTime} is null or s.collected_at <= #{endTime}) order by s.collected_at asc, s.id asc
order by s.collected_at desc, s.id desc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}

select * from grain_temp_summary where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and (#{startTime} is null or collected_at >= #{startTime}) and (#{endTime} is null or collected_at <= #{endTime}) order by collected_at asc
